meta.title: Kıvanç Öğrenci Yurdu — Female Student Residence in Avcılar, Istanbul
meta.description: A private residence for female students in Avcılar, Istanbul. Secure, professionally managed rooms minutes from Istanbul's private universities.

hero.title: A student residence that feels like home
hero.lede: A private residence for female students in the heart of Avcılar — professionally managed, secure around the clock, and a short walk from the Metrobüs that reaches five university campuses in under half an hour.
hero.imageAlt: Students relaxing in a bright, modern residence common area

rooms.title: Rooms made for study and rest
rooms.lede: Three room types in a single, purpose-run building for female students — the same facilities and the same service whichever you choose. Bills, cleaning, laundry and meals are included in every one.
rooms.disclaimer: Pricing shown is a placeholder. Final rates depend on room type, contract length and the meal plan you choose — contact us for the current price list.

f1.name: Single Room
f1.desc: Your own room with a private bathroom, a full-size desk and plenty of storage — for students who want quiet and focus.
f1.alt: Single room with a bed, study desk and large window

f2.name: Shared Twin Room
f2.desc: Two single beds, two desks and two wardrobes in a generous room with a shared bathroom on the floor. Our most popular choice.

f3.name: Shared Triple Room
f3.desc: The most affordable option, without cutting corners: three separate beds, desks and wardrobes, plus the same facilities as every other room.

uni.title: Close to where you study
uni.lede: Avcılar sits directly on the Metrobüs corridor, with İstanbul Gelişim inside the district itself and four more campuses within half an hour along the same line. Travel times below are door-to-door by public transport.
uni.note: Travel times are typical off-peak estimates by public transport and can vary with traffic and time of day.

about.title: Built for students. Answerable to parents.
about.p1: Most of our residents move to Istanbul from another city, and for their families that first year is a leap of faith. We built Kıvanç around that reality: one properly staffed building, clear rules, transparent pricing, and someone reachable whenever a parent needs an answer.
about.p2: We're not a large chain. The residence is run day to day by the same family that has owned it since 2013, which is why the standards hold.

faq.title: Before you apply
faq.lede: If your question isn't here, call or message us — we answer in Turkish and English, seven days a week.

1.q: How do I apply for a room?
1.a: Send us the form at the bottom of this page or message us on WhatsApp with your name, university and preferred room type. We'll confirm availability, invite you for a visit, and hold the room with a deposit once you decide.

2.a: The standard contract runs for the academic year, from September to June. Summer stays and shorter terms are available on request, subject to availability.

3.q: What does the monthly price include?
3.a: Rent, all utilities, fibre internet, weekly room cleaning, laundry facilities, use of the study lounges and gym, and the daily meal plan. There is no separate bill at the end of the month.

4.q: Can parents visit, and what are the security rules?
4.a: Families are welcome during visiting hours and are received in the ground-floor lounge. Entry to the residence floors is by keycard and limited to residents and staff. Every entrance is monitored, and reception is staffed 24 hours a day.

5.a: Monthly by bank transfer, or in instalments agreed at signing. We issue a receipt for every payment and never ask for cash without documentation.

6.a: Yes. The building closes at 23:00 on weekdays and at midnight at weekends. A student who needs to return later, or to stay out overnight, arranges it with the resident manager in advance and her family is informed.
